summary: Hong Kong-based Solowin Holdings, a Nasdaq-listed broker-dealer, filed a 6-K disclosing issuance of Pre-Paid Purchase #3 to Streeterville Capital under a February 9, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement, alongside a Side Letter with Vast Space. PPP #3 carries a $2,160,000 principal ($160,000 OID), $2,000,000 purchase price, 8% interest, unsecured, with monthly $300,000 cash amortization from January 1, 2027. Failure permits share settlement at 85% of the lower of prior close or 10-day VWAP, capped at 9.99% beneficial ownership. The Side Letter barred earnout transfers to Vast Space tied to the AlloyX Limited acquisition and mandated 5,250,000 pre-delivery shares at $0.0001. Watch dilution, amortization funding, and trigger-event risk.
